jobs.goal: A designer builds a whole game as a pack and never touches code or configuration; whatever a designer changes is pack data, and the hardware scanner gets its rules as generated tables, never new firmware. jobs.goal: Every fact and reply on a screen carries a label: how old, how sure, paper or live. Red means act now; grey means not installed or switched off; an unreadable list shows unknown. One pure Verdict, speaking healthy, down or dormant, answers the editor, the preflight and the start gate, and reaches the screen. The preflight says what it cannot check; a missing or broken profile refuses the start.
